lead.title: Sobi wins a positive CHMP opinion for Tryngolza (olezarsen) in severe hypertriglyceridemia
lead.deck: The EMA committee recommends Ionis’s antisense medicine, licensed to Sobi outside the US, for adults with fasting triglycerides ≥ 880 mg/dL (10 mmol/L). The Phase III CORE and CORE2 trials show up to a 72% triglyceride reduction and 85% fewer acute pancreatitis episodes; the European Commission decision is expected in Q4 2026.

milestone.title: Modus Therapeutics pauses enrollment in its sevuparin Phase IIa after a serious adverse event
milestone.summary: One patient in Part 2 of the study in anemia of chronic kidney disease (two Italian centers) had a SUSAR: a link to the drug can be neither ruled out nor established. The pause is voluntary and no other patient was on treatment.
milestone.why: The proof-of-concept readout slips to Q1 2027 and cash, extended by the September 2026 share issue, is guided into Q2 2027: a reminder of timeline risk for small listed biotechs.

deal.thesis: A $200M IPO for a next-generation RNAi developer: three medicines in or near the clinic, plus early work on delivering RNAi beyond the liver. A direct comparable for European extrahepatic-delivery startups such as Undecimal Bio.

brefsIntl.title: Iambic, an AI drug-discovery specialist, raises $150M in an IPO
brefsIntl.summary: In regulatory filings the company says its AI approach could upend traditional drug discovery. A market window for AI platforms that European startups can read as an exit signal.

word.definition: A library of millions to billions of molecules, each tagged with a short DNA code that identifies which one binds a target.

parts.label: Protein target
parts.role: the bait the library is fished against

how.t: Building blocks are assembled in split-and-pool cycles; each reaction is recorded in the attached DNA.
The library is exposed to the immobilized target; non-binders are washed away.
The remaining codes are amplified by PCR and sequenced: the most enriched point to the hit molecules.

word.why: VC angle: screening billions of molecules in one tube cuts hit-finding cost and feeds a whole class of platforms (PROTACs, glues, RNA delivery). Undecimal Bio, launched with an $18M seed, uses it to find siRNA carriers beyond the liver.

startups.name: Undecimal Bio
startups.use: DELiveri platform: DEL-style library screening to find conjugates that carry siRNA beyond the liver, starting with renovascular disease; $18M seed

startups.name: Vipergen
startups.use: DEL drug-discovery services, with the YoctoReactor and Binder Trap Enrichment platforms

startups.name: HitGen
startups.use: Reference DEL player, outside Europe and not a startup: a comparable, with announced collaborations with Takeda and Kymera
